newsitem.title: UK: London gold prices bounces for firmer fixing.
newsitem.headline: London gold prices bounces for firmer fixing.

text.p: GOLD - Fixed at $354.45, up $2.00 from AM. Short covering on Comex helped lift price. Could try higher but bearish tone still dominant. $356.50 seen as possible short-term top.
SILVER - Couple of cents firmer behind gold. Currently $4.70/$4.72 unchanged.
PLATINUM - Up a dollar at $360.00/$361.00. With gold.
PALLADIUM - Barely moved from $1.50 down at $120.00/$121.00.
